export_policy.resource_accounting: Sum persisted Run usage once per Run. Internal SDK measurements share the parent container and are not added. Incomplete samples are lower bounds.
export_policy.status_semantics: Run state, attempt state, Result operation status, scientific checks, and pytest outcome are separate facts; none is inferred from another.
